title: Uniform maximal path point distribution
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number. Choose a level uniformly from $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, then sample a finite subset according to the maximal path prefix distribution at that level. The resulting probability mass function is the distribution of the sampled subset.
caveat: The definition of maximal path prefix is not included, so its precise meaning cannot be stated here.
